**Can a staff member increase their pension contribution above the minimum?** Yes, this can be arranged directly with payroll at any time. **Does opting out affect any other Alderbridge benefit?** No, pension scheme membership is entirely separate from other benefits.

A staff member may choose the salary sacrifice contribution method instead of the standard method, which can offer a tax and National Insurance efficiency; payroll explains both options clearly at enrolment so the choice is genuinely informed rather than defaulted to whichever method is administratively simpler.

Closing note

A workplace pension is a meaningful long-term benefit, and this guidance exists to make sure every staff member understands their own choices about it clearly from day one.

Workplace Pension Scheme: What You Need to Know

Purpose and scope

This guidance explains the workplace pension scheme available to Alderbridge staff. It applies to every eligible employee across every site.

Policy statement

Alderbridge automatically enrols an eligible staff member into the workplace pension scheme, meeting its legal auto-enrolment duty while making it straightforward for a staff member to understand their own options.

Definitions

**Auto-enrolment** the legal requirement to enrol an eligible staff member into a pension scheme automatically. **Opt-out** a staff member's choice to leave the scheme after being enrolled, which they may do at any time. **Salary sacrifice** an alternative contribution method some staff may choose, reducing gross salary in exchange for an equivalent pension contribution.

1. Automatically enrol every eligible staff member into the pension scheme from their qualifying start date.
2. Provide clear information about contribution rates and the opt-out process at enrolment.
3. Process an opt-out request within the statutory window, refunding any contribution already deducted where the opt-out is timely.
4. Re-enrol an opted-out staff member automatically every three years, as required by law, unless they choose to opt out again.

Interaction with other Alderbridge policies

This guidance works alongside the Staff Benefits Guidance (the wider set of benefits this scheme sits alongside) and payroll's own processing calendar for contribution deductions.

Worked example

A worked example illustrates the opt-out window. A new staff member is auto-enrolled on their start date, and decides within the first month that they would prefer to opt out for now. Payroll processes this within the statutory window and refunds the single contribution already deducted, and the staff member is told they will be automatically re-enrolled in three years unless they opt out again at that point.

Frequently asked questions
